DB-047(e) FINITENESS GATE (binding): canConvert requires >= MIN_DRAWN_VERTICES FINITE points (Number.isFinite on both lng and lat); the wrapper/status point count reports FINITE points (matching what the overlay renders); a persistent hint explains why Convert is disabled when non-finite rows exist. NO change to any finite-value flow: placing/typing valid points, converting, adopting behave byte-identically (the accepted specs prove it). The bridge request contract is untouched (outline-bridge-api.ts FORBIDDEN).
